title: The Arithmetic of Power
description: Minister Vostane has requested a meeting at the Finance Ministry — not the palace. She has modeled four fiscal scenarios and wants you to understand the full picture before the budget allocation. This determines your government's economic direction.

title: Economic Direction — The Deciding Debate
description: Vostane and Marić present competing visions. Free market vs. planned economy. This decision will shape every economic policy for the rest of your term.

title: Budget Allocation — Fiscal Year 1963
description: The formal budget must be submitted to parliament by the end of the month. Revenue 380M, expenditure 445M, deficit 65M. Your allocations will determine what this government prioritizes and what it sacrifices.

title: The Architect's Question
description: Jonas has asked you to come by his study. His tone on the phone was the careful kind — the kind he uses when he's been rehearsing what he wants to say.

title: Questions About Grandfather
description: Liora submitted a records request to the Halvek Era Crimes Archive. She has what came back and she wants to talk.

title: The Weight of Kravenstal
description: Gallery Seven at the Sarenka pit collapsed at shift change. Forty-one men on the register. The company belongs to Veltrian Consolidated Collieries — everyone in Kravenstal knows whose company that really is.

title: The Investigation Question
description: Danika needs a decision on how far to take this.
